name: Auto-GPT styled decision-making benchmark
description: A benchmark study of Auto-GPT styled agents in decision-making tasks simulating real-world scenarios, comparing popular LLMs and evaluating the Additional Opinions algorithm for enhanced online decision-making performance.
reputation: A niche research benchmark from an early Auto-GPT-style decision-making study, with limited evidence of broad community adoption.
notes: Includes evaluation of popular LLMs and introduces Additional Opinions algorithm to improve performance without fine-tuning foundational LLMs.
